pop_open_priv_mo_002: Consent to Collection and Use of Personal Information by Korea Post Korea Post collects and uses your personal information as follows for the operation of the PHILAKOREA 2025 World Stamp Exhibition (“the Exhibition”). Please read the following [Consent to Collection and Use of Personal Information] carefully. You may proceed with pre-registration and on-site check-in only if you agree. Any matters not specified herein shall follow Korea Post’s Privacy Policy (https://www.koreapost.go.kr/). [Consent to Collection and Use of Personal Information] Data Controller: Korea Post Collected Items & Purpose of Use: (Required) Mobile Number To verify pre-registration status, manage on-site check-in and visitor identification, provide exhibition-related notifications, conduct satisfaction and participation surveys, and distribute rewards (including giveaways) (Required) Nickname To distinguish pre-registered visitors, link check-in records, identify participants of experience programs (e.g., Stamp Tour, Treasure Hunt), collect user activity data, and manage participation history and rewards (Optional) Experience-Related Data Usage history, participation records, and activity data for each program—used for statistical analysis to improve future services and satisfaction Retention Period & Disposal: All collected data will be retained until October 31, 2025 for post-exhibition analysis. After this date, data will be safely and irreversibly destroyed. Refusal to Consent: You may choose not to consent to the collection and use of personal information. However, doing so may limit your access to pre-registration, on-site participation, and reward eligibility.

home_main_001: A global cultural festival connecting the world through stamps
home_main_002: The PHILAKOREA 2025 World Stamp Exhibition is Korea’s largest international stamp fair, officially recognized by the International Philatelic Federation (FIP). By merging digital innovation with traditional philatelic heritage, the exhibition offers immersive experiences that highlight the artistic, historical, and educational value of stamps. Visitors can explore a wide range of programs including: Themed exhibitions, International competitions, Hands-on experience zones, Stamp tours Through future-focused content such as digital pavilions, global stamp auctions, and AI-powered experiences, the exhibition aims to become a cultural platform enjoyed by all generations, while showcasing the prestige of Korea’s postal culture on the global stage.
home_main_space_027: The Pinnacle of Global Stamp Art
home_main_space_029: Authentic Local Products, Handpicked by Korea Post
space_detail_003: Heritage of the times, revived with stamps
space_detail_004: Stamps go beyond simple records and capture the cultural heritage of the times in a small square frame. Through stamp designs linked to intangible cultural assets and actual exhibitions, Visually experience the deep meaning and emotion of cultural heritage.
space_detail_006: Timeless Art Born from the Artist’s Touch
space_detail_007: Stamps become a new canvas in the hands of artists. This space showcases limited-edition eternal stamps created in collaboration with artists, along with sculptural pieces inspired by them. Experience an expanded vision of art where original paintings and real stamps coexist.
space_detail_010: From K-pop and musicals to characters and cuisine, Korea’s vibrant culture—admired worldwide—comes alive through stamps. With immersive videos, vivid imagery, and curated commentary, this exhibition offers a rich, multisensory experience of K-Culture.
space_detail_012: A Warm Connection Through a Single Letter
space_detail_013: Letters, as emotional bridges, connect people across time and distance. Discover heartfelt stories from the 2025 Letter Writing Contest and historically significant letters that illustrate the emotional bond between stamps and written words. Try writing your own letter on-site, and experience how one message can connect hearts.
space_detail_016: Stamps serve as small windows into the natural world, quietly delivering messages of conservation. Featuring designs inspired by natural monuments and endangered species, this space combines stamps with real plant displays to highlight the importance of preserving biodiversity and promoting sustainable ecosystems.
space_detail_018: A Designer’s Eye, Framed in Stamps
space_detail_019: Explore the philosophies and techniques of stamp designers through never-before-seen original artworks and sketches.Under the theme Design Movements, this exhibit captures the evolving spirit of design and experimentation across eras.
space_detail_021: Over 140 Years of Korean Stamps In celebration of the 140st anniversary of Korea’s postal history, this exhibition brings together stamps that have chronicled the nation’s modern journey—from art and sports to nature and diplomacy. Discover how a single stamp can hold decades of history within a frame of paper.
space_detail_024: A Journey Around the World Through Stamps Begins at Your Fingertips
space_detail_025: Select a country on the floating globe using the tablet,  and discover the stories, history, and culture told through its stamps. Experience firsthand how a single stamp can connect the entire world.
space_detail_028: AI analyzes your facial expression to recommend a stamp that mirrors your current emotion—joy, surprise, calm, and more. A unique blend of data and emotion helps you uncover feelings you may not have even noticed.
space_detail_030: The Further You Focus, the Farther It Flies
space_detail_031: Measure your brainwaves to test your concentration—then launch a virtual letter as far as your focus allows. A playful yet visual way to explore the power of mental clarity, for kids and adults alike.
space_detail_033: Drawn by a Robot, Inspired by You
space_detail_034: Robotics and AI combine to recognize your face in real time and sketch your portrait directly onto a stamp-shaped canvas. Witness every precise line come to life—and take home a one-of-a-kind stamp of yourself.
space_detail_037: Draw freely on the touchscreen as AI adjusts background, tone, and style to unify your creation with others. A creative and collaborative experiment where every gesture becomes part of a larger masterpiece.
space_detail_039: Turn Your Face into a Stamp
space_detail_040: AI captures your face and seamlessly blends it into a stamp frame—creating your very own collectible portrait stamp. Experience the future of philately, where identity and design meet in a digital keepsake.
space_detail_043: AI recognizes your face and animates mouth movements to create a stamp that appears to talk. Go beyond static imagery with this interactive experience that brings voice and personality to your stamp.
space_detail_046: Color Your Imagination onto a Stamp
space_detail_047: Choose from stamp templates featuring various themes and eras, and bring them to life with your colors. Whether you're a child or an adult, express your emotions and creativity through every brushstroke.
space_detail_050: Use a blank stamp frame to freely illustrate your own theme and turn it into a one-of-a-kind stamp. Discover the creative process behind stamp design and immerse yourself in your artistic vision.
space_detail_052: Build a Miniature Story, Block by Block
space_detail_053: Assemble tiny blocks into stamp-inspired shapes or symbols in this hands-on activity.
With: focused attention and creativity, create a small yet meaningful piece of miniature art.
space_detail_056: Create your own acrylic keyring using a stamp image you've colored or one inspired by the exhibition.
perfect: keepsake that blends design flair with practical charm.
space_detail_058: Shape a Stamp-Inspired Magnet with Clay
space_detail_059: Mold soft clay into a magnetic object inspired by stamp designs. A playful, tactile experience that turns into a personal memento.
space_detail_061: Fold the Beauty of Nature by Hand
space_detail_062: Inspired by flower-themed stamps, this analog activity invites you to fold, cut, and craft paper into delicate floral forms. A sensory journey where stamps, nature, and handmade elegance bloom together.
space_detail_064: The Pinnacle of Global Stamp Art
space_detail_065: Stamps poised between competition and creativity.
space_detail_066: Discover the finest works—from traditional philately to thematics, postcards, and youth collections—submitted by passionate collectors around the world. Beyond collecting, each curated stamp reveals the artistic value of a miniature masterpiece.
space_detail_068: Authentic Local Products, Handpicked by Korea Post
space_detail_069: A showcase of taste and craftsmanship from every corner of Korea.
space_detail_070: Explore trusted regional products—from fresh produce to SME goods—carefully selected by Korea Post and available for purchase on-site. Experience Korea’s local pride through reliable delivery and sincere curation.
space_detail_073: One-of-a-kind stamps, gathered from around the world.
space_detail_074: See the history, culture, and print techniques preserved in these rarest pieces—fragile sheets that have endured decades. Step into the profound world of stamp collecting and witness the value of time made visible.

tre_detail_type_002: Please select the topic you want.
tre_detail_result_trd1_004: Seek the pride of New Zealand’s postal heritage in the face of Zealandia, who crossed imperial seas with the dream of uniting the world through a single postage rate.
tre_detail_result_trd2_004: Follow the stamp bearing a tribal seal layered atop Ottoman traces, marking the beginning of a new tradition in the land of Hejaz.
tre_detail_result_trd3_004: Look for the classic Danish stamp—its disciplined design and sharp edges capture the authority and order of the royal family, the origin of Nordic postal tradition.
tre_detail_result_trd4_004: The first stamp ever to bear the name “Republic of Korea”—the treasure lies at the starting point of Korea’s journey after liberation.
tre_detail_result_trd5_004: Trace the revival of indigenous identity through printing and design—Bolivia’s stamps reflect the restoration of tradition after a colonial past.
tre_detail_result_hty1_004: Explore the early voice of a newly liberated nation through stamps issued between 1946 and 1950—before the outbreak of war.
tre_detail_result_hty2_004: Discover the maritime postal route that connected Brazil and Portugal—even across the vast Atlantic—carrying hope and news in every letter.
tre_detail_result_hty3_004: Through two world wars and colonial rule, find traces of repression and resilience in the censored stamps that once carried messages through troubled times.
tre_detail_result_hty4_004: Uncover the emotions and authority of a transforming monarchy through the letters and stamps from the twilight of an empire.
tre_detail_result_hty5_004: Under the fading light of empire, follow the delicate prints and overprints that echo Hungary’s royal dignity and desperate resilience in early 20th-century stamps.
tre_detail_result_thm1_004: Explore a chronicle of birds—their habitats, their mysteries, and the wonder of nature hidden beneath their feathers.
tre_detail_result_thm2_004: As graceful as a swan on stage, yet stirring without wings—discover the essence of ballet captured in stamps.
tre_detail_result_thm3_004: From bitter medicines to bold defenses—find a scene in time as seen through a pharmacist’s eyes in stamps that record humanity’s fight against illness.
tre_detail_result_thm4_004: In an era when small errors meant great disaster, uncover stamps that mark society’s earliest efforts to prevent accidents and protect lives.
tre_detail_result_thm5_004: Step into the fantastical—where mythical creatures and vivid colors bring imagined worlds to life within the borders of a single stamp.
tre_detail_result_avt1_004: In the 1920s, the first airmail era began in the Dutch East Indies. Discover the path of traditional aviation between colony and homeland through local patterns and airplane silhouettes.
tre_detail_result_avt2_004: With the outbreak of World War II, Argentina's airmail routes stretched faster and farther. Trace the enduring journeys of flight that continued even amid war.
tre_detail_result_avt3_004: Founded in 1919, SCADTA was Latin America’s first civilian airline. Follow the flow of airmail history across the Panama Isthmus, where planes flew with the rhythm of the sea.
tre_detail_result_avt4_004: In 1911, the world’s first continuous airmail service took off in Britain. Look for a soaring moment in history, where celebration and winged addresses came together.
tre_detail_result_avt5_004: Explore the traces of the first and rare flights launched in Honduras. Follow the adventurous journeys across Central American skies, now captured in stamps.
tre_detail_result_pht1_004: From 1881 to 1936, a journey through the growth and transformation of Vietnam’s railway system under French colonial rule. Find the stamp that captures this historic passage.
tre_detail_result_pht2_004: Beyond the red doors and through spice-scented alleys, discover the stories and daily lives of the people of Zanzibar, delicately framed in a single stamp.
tre_detail_result_pht3_004: Seek the quiet golden moments printed on aged postcards—snapshots of Herceg Novi's alleys and seaside from a time long past.
tre_detail_result_pht4_004: Journey into the rivers and forests of Bangladesh, and find the stamp that captures traces of wild life and landscapes as if painted by nature itself.
tre_detail_result_pht5_004: Along the railroad tracks, the first 20 years of the town of Novska are filled with scenes of longing. Discover them through the lens of a stamp.
tre_detail_result_yth1_004: The clumsy dreams and wild imaginations once hidden inside you—now reborn as tiny, adorable monsters. Find the stamp that mirrors your younger self.
tre_detail_result_yth2_004: While others run, you choose to walk—like Titan the donkey. Look for the stamp that celebrates going slow, but staying true to yourself.
tre_detail_result_yth3_004: There was a time when you poured your heart into handwritten letters. Find the postcard-like stamp where sincerity spoke louder than words.
tre_detail_result_yth4_004: Like the legend of a stone that gives you courage, there’s a stamp that gently helps reveal the truths you couldn’t say out loud.
tre_detail_result_yth5_004: More precious than the glittering tree was the anticipation and thrill inside it. Find the stamp that reflects those long-lost feelings.
